answer: A dark sable reputation token, non-transferable and earned only through verified work, marks genuine participants. Sybil resistance can come from a bonded identity vault: each agent locks a stake that is slashed if its pulse of activity ever forks into duplicate identities. An attacker must burn real stake per fake identity and forfeit the sable token on detection, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
